Players Committee card image of [[Yoda, Keeper Of The Peace (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploys -1 to Coruscant. May lose 1 Force to cancel Force Lightning targeting your character present. Neither player may draw more than one battle destiny here (those destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). Immune to attrition.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/yodakeeperofthepeace.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/716c892f7089f2780444868a190e545fbe098583 716c892] (14 October 2019). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
